detailed_descriptions.en: Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series! CHARACTER Asagi Igawa (Voice: Hina Nakase) The leader of the Taimanin, who is also recognized as the strongest among them. She makes use of genius-level swordplay and martial arts, as well as blindingly fast speed, as she fights for justice against the forces of darkness. While she managed to take down Oboro, a ninja allied with the demons, in a fight to the death in the Chaos Arena, she lost her lover, Kyousuke Sawaki. Asagi had initially wound up in the Chaos Arena after being captured by Oboro, but ultimately slain her once more. And now, she once again go on missions as a Taimanin. Sakura Igawa (Voice: Koko Kuroiwa) Asagi's younger sister. A beautiful girl who comes off as both lively and determined. After helping her older sister through the many precarious trials and tribulations of the Chaos Arena, Sakura has officially become a Taimanin as well. STORY Asagi and Sakura head to a man-made island off the coast of Tokyo Bay in order to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action. What lies in wait is a city abandoned midway through development and now overrun with demons and criminals; a lawless district where debauchery reigns supreme.

Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series!

CHARACTER

Asagi Igawa (Voice: Hina Nakase)

The leader of the Taimanin, who is also recognized as the strongest among them.

She makes use of genius-level swordplay and martial arts, as well as blindingly fast speed, as she fights for justice against the forces of darkness.

While she managed to take down Oboro, a ninja allied with the demons, in a fight to the death in the Chaos Arena, she lost her lover, Kyousuke Sawaki.

Asagi had initially wound up in the Chaos Arena after being captured by Oboro, but ultimately slain her once more.

And now, she once again go on missions as a Taimanin.

Sakura Igawa (Voice: Koko Kuroiwa)

Asagi's younger sister.

A beautiful girl who comes off as both lively and determined.

After helping her older sister through the many precarious trials and tribulations of the Chaos Arena, Sakura has officially become a Taimanin as well.

STORY

Asagi and Sakura head to a man-made island off the coast of Tokyo Bay in order to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action. What lies in wait is a city abandoned midway through development and now overrun with demons and criminals; a lawless district where debauchery reigns supreme.
